observations.title: Map of Saskatchewan Showing Completed Watershed Plans
observations.role: Whole-feature comparison and naming-scope assessment for all three selected targets
observations.observation: The entire map and all target regions were inspected. The first selected cluster lacks a local water label. The second lies by Royal Lake, Steephill Lake and Reindeer River but its long southern tip is not established by the broadened mapped water. The third broad west-east basin lies west of Wood Lake in the connected Churchill setting. Context labels do not resolve whole-feature naming coverage. Multiple map views count as one publication. The printed production date differs from the URL date directory.
